hypothesis: Fine-tuning the existing small Gemma 4 assistant on target-generated, campaign-like text will increase accepted target tokens per combined assistant-plus-verifier CUDA second and thereby reduce exact c32 endpoint service time without changing target-model output.
stock_controls: unchanged google/gemma-4-31B-it-assistant checkpoint at the bound revision
candidate: one bounded fine-tune of the bound official assistant; confirmed Gemma 4 EAGLE-3 warm start is allowed only after one localized MTP trainer compatibility attempt

identities.runtime_starting_point: official vLLM 0.26.0+cu129; exact source or wheel identity must be frozen before science
identities.hardware: two independent 1x NVIDIA H200 SXM 141GB benches for online training, then one retained H200 for matched endpoint evaluation

required: all measured requests complete with finite outputs
runtime probability-preservation or greedy-equivalence contract passes
no target checkpoint or sampler-policy change
quality_and_correctness.broad_quality_evaluation: deferred until a positive performance frontier

measurements.primary: accepted target tokens per combined assistant-plus-target-verification CUDA second
secondary: price-normalized dollars per million total tokens

promotion.holdout: trained checkpoint improves accepted-target-tokens per combined CUDA second over the unchanged assistant with a positive whole-request bound
promotion.endpoint: retain any reproducible positive endpoint result; only a matched sustainable result at or below the campaign target can close the campaign objective

failure_handling.ordinary_integration_failure: patch in place under the same retained session and continue if the next materially changed attempt can start within ten minutes
failure_handling.training_failure: stop after the bounded pilot when neither held-out loss nor acceptance efficiency improves
failure_handling.mtp_trainer_incompatibility: after one localized adapter attempt, use the confirmed Gemma 4 EAGLE-3 warm-start path rather than building a custom trainer
failure_handling.teardown: director deletes both compute resources and attached storage, verifies provider absence, and reconciles exposure
